messages:
Priya (DevEx): Hey everyone — we just cut the open-source release for redwood-client v1.0.0! 🎉
Priya (DevEx): Highlights: stable inference client API, streaming responses, improved batching heuristics, and a new CONTRIBUTING + quantization guide. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-client/releases/tag/v1.0.0
deploy-bot: Released redwood-client v1.0.0 — artifacts published to GitHub and PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/redwood-client/1.0.0
Jordan (OSS Maintainer): Amazing — congrats! Quick Q: is v0.x still supported? Any breaking changes we should call out?
Priya (DevEx): Good Q — v0.x is EOL in 90 days. Breaking: client config API renamed `batching` -> `batch_config`. Migration snippet:
Priya (DevEx): ```py
# v0.x
client = RedwoodClient(batching=BatchingConfig(max_tokens=1024))
# v1.0 ->
client = RedwoodClient(batch_config=BatchConfig(max_tokens=1024))
```
Ethan (Infra): For Dedicated customers we auto-translate v0 calls for 60 days; see ops-runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-runbook/pull/142
Marta (Community): We'll host a maintainer AMA + migration office hours tomorrow 10:00 PT — RSVP: https://cal.com/redwood/maintainers (will record)
Sam (Marketing): Can design + docs teams get the logo assets and tweet copy? I'll draft a blog post and tweet thread.
Priya (DevEx): Uploaded assets and the draft in the release PR. @Sam please review the copy in the PR description.
Alex (Security): Quick sec note: no key or credential format changes in the client. Ran the security checklist — no issues flagged.
Jordan (OSS Maintainer): I'll update CONTRIBUTING.md to add the new maintainer rotation schedule and add a short migration guide to the repo root.
Marta (Community): tagging community volunteers @opensource-vols — if you can help triage issues this week that'd be awesome :heart:
Sam (Marketing): Draft blurb for approval: "redwood-client v1.0 brings a stable API, production-ready batching, and streaming support to simplify inference at scale." Thumbs?
Priya (DevEx): :thumbsup: from me. Thanks team — shout if you spot any regressions or docs gaps.
Community Bot: Thread archived to release-index and linked from weekly release notes.
